status: Frozen before new sample selection, feature generation or heldout head evaluation
purpose: Fresh controlled frozen-encoder and shallow content-bypass study; not a trained multimodal backbone
historical_exclusion: Exclude every clean selection and corrupted-input content SHA256 in the corresponding next/encoder manifest, plus all prior SST normalized-text hashes for AG News; deduplicate all new splits
checkpoint_selection: Minimum validation cross entropy at updates 50/100/150/200/250/300; confirmation is evaluated only after each model selection
linear_reference: Multinomial logistic regression C=1, max_iter=1000, fitted on new training global features only; the same frozen coefficients form the additive content bypass
bypass: Fixed coefficient one; no fitted blend or test-based choice; all dynamic branches initialized identically to their dynamic_head counterparts
control: FullHX, same_call_sigmoid and ordinary_c1 share the identical recurrence, trainable leaves, initialization, states, data and optimizer updates; ordinary_c1 replaces both fixed gate shapes
primary_family: 8 paired contrasts: FullHX minus ordinary_c1 for each of 2 datasets x 2 regimes x clean/corrupted test
primary_rule: Report all paired five-seed differences with Student-t intervals; apply Bonferroni family-wise 95% intervals across 8 contrasts. A financial-specific benefit gate requires corrected lower bounds >0 and mean >=0.01 in BOTH clean and corrupted tests on BOTH datasets in at least one prespecified regime. This does not establish equal-quality cost superiority.
secondary: Same-Call sigmoid, GRU, Transformer, stand-alone global linear, calibration, all costs and states; no retrospective gate changes

raw_corruption.ag_news: 25 percent word deletion before tokenization with fixed new RNG; complete encoding including global feature
raw_corruption.cifar10: Central 16x16 original image square set to 128 before resize and complete encoding

representation: 16 local features plus global mean, training-only PCA64 with whitening, all dt=1; static unimodal probes
freeze: Hash protocol and execution sources before selection; recheck before every training run; preserve failed attempts
cost: Record actual encoder generation, PCA, compilation, optimizer, validation, inference and fixed tables. Measure raw-input-to-logits on CPU after compilation. No energy, GPU or equal-quality frontier claim.
limitations: New samples are disjoint within this tools/hcsn project; pretrained encoder overlap is unaudited
Five training seeds share one sampled dataset; seed intervals are conditional on these examples
Fixed financial parameters and a compiled Hermite lookup; no end-to-end financial parameter learning
A shallow frozen content bypass is not a jointly trained full backbone
Parameters and updates are matched approximately across GRU/Transformer, not FLOPs or persistent state
